name: readonly-database
description: Run read-only SQL queries against an analytics or reporting database. No write tool exists in this manifest at all — the strongest form of least privilege is a permission that was never wired up on the plugin side, not just one that's ungranted.

tools.name: run_query
tools.description: Execute a SELECT-only SQL query and return rows. The plugin implementation is expected to reject any statement that isn't a SELECT before it ever reaches the database driver — this manifest documents the intent, it doesn't enforce it by itself.

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: Return column names and types for a given table, so an agent can write a correct query without guessing the schema.
